notable_absence.finding: Code-sample page walking through couchbase.replace()'s three CAS modes (no_cas always succeeds, bad_cas always fails with LCB_KEY_EEXISTS, good_cas succeeds by reading the current CAS first via couchbase.get()). This is standard Data Service optimistic-concurrency (CAS) behavior, not an Eventing-specific mechanism - the same CAS semantics apply to any KV client.
